name: warmupbound
tagline: How many bars an EMA, RSI or ATR needs before its seed can't change a tick, proven
trendOrigin: OpenCharts (Trend 1) ships 20+ indicators and a PineScript transpiler. Charting tools and backtests disagree on indicator values for the first N bars because each one seeds recursive indicators differently. None of them says how long that disagreement can last.

warnings: the spec promised a benchmark and none is present
